Ethan: Heads-up  DeltaFold wants to POC their internal family (deltafold-13b-custom). Requirements: streaming chat, function-calls, 40k token KV sessions, EU residency + customer-managed KMS. Can we scope a quick compatibility run?
Zara: Good call. Do they plan to push weights to our S3 or provide HF links? Any docs on tokenizer?
Ethan: Theyll upload a tarball to our secure S3 and share a manifest. Tokenizer is a BPE variant with custom merges and ~10 special tokens.
Clara: Key checks: tokenizer id/vocab mapping, attention type (they mentioned rotary+alibi mix), layernorm variant, and grouped-query compatibility. Also check whether KV format is standard causal (we expect K,V per layer).
Marta: Commercial note: hosted POC is easiest for them but less predictable for p95. Dedicated reserved (3/6mo) gives stable latency and a volume discount. For a 13B model q4_kv usually halves token cost vs fp16; expect small extra decode latency (+10ms/token).
Clara: Plan: 1) ingest weights + tokenizer -> run compat-scan (tokenizer + kernel mapping) 2) build recommended variants (fp16, q4_kv, try int8 if feasible) 3) run 48h canary on Dedicated for realistic p95 + cost numbers 4) KMS + residency signoff with infosec/legal.
Ethan: Customer asked if we guarantee correctness for 40k token sessions. Short answer?
Clara: We support sharded KV and continuous prefix caching. For 40k tokens well validate sharding logic and memory footprint; may recommend segmented sessions or a dedicated larger-instance pool. We'll flag any runtime limits.
Zara: Security request: they need us to fill an infosec questionnaire and require customer-managed KMS. Also want audit logs and key rotation policy. We should ask for KMS cert endpoint and threat model notes.
OpsBot: created ticket ONB-238765 (steps: receive weights -> tokenizer sanity -> compat-scan -> variant build -> 48h dedicated canary -> KMS/residency review).
Marta: Assignments: @Clara -> compat-scan + variant recommendations, @Zara -> infosec/legal thread, @Marta -> pricing/commercial, @Ethan -> customer coord + presigned S3.
Ethan: Can we give them a sample curl showing streaming + function-calls they can test while we build variants?
Clara: Yes, sample below (will replace model_id after we build the q4_kv variant):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY'
  -d '{"model":"deltafold-13b-q4_kv","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize usage last month"}],"functions":[{"name":"email_report","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"to":{"type":"string"}}}}]}'
```
Zara: Timeline: initial compat feedback within 2 business days after weights + tokenizer land. Full canary numbers after 48h run.
Marta: Pricing: I'll draft a POC quote with hosted vs 3mo/6mo dedicated tiers and a one-time onboarding fee for engineering work.
Clara: While waiting for weights I'll run a synthetic against a similar open 13B to get rough perf baselines. That helps DeltaFold set expectations.
Ethan: Great. I'll ask them for the S3 presign and the completed questionnaire now and update the ticket. :rocket:
